source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the components of the immune system (PDF 176-177).

blocks.text: Immune system aik jagah nahi: yeh bohat se alag cells se bana hai jo infection ki jagah daurte hain. Yeh safaid khoon ke cells hain jo bone marrow mein bante, khoon aur lymph mein ghoomte, aur lymph nodes, tilli, jigar, thymus aur bone marrow mein bhi milte hain. In ki teen bari qismein hain: monocytes, T cells aur B cells; T aur B cells mil kar lymphocytes kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ka khaaka jis mein immune system ke aaza: gale mein tonsils aur adenoids, gardan, baghal aur raan ke jor par lymph nodes, inhein jorti lymphatic vessels, seene mein thymus, pet ke baayen taraf tilli (spleen), appendix, aur raan ki haddiyon mein bone marrow.

blocks.text: Monocytes bone marrow mein bante hain. Yeh khoon mein ghoom kar interstitial mayi mein jate hain jahan macrophages mein pukhta ho kar jaraseem nigalte aur tabah karte, aur aise proteins banate hain jo helper T cells ko chalu karte hain. Monocytes doosre phagocytes mein bhi pukhta hote hain jo jigar, tilli, lymph nodes aur doosre tissues mein rehte aur cells ke malbe ki safai aur tissue ki marammat mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke monocytes lymphoid tissues mein bante hain. Yeh sahi nahi: monocytes, doosre safaid khoon ke cells ki tarah, bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain; kitab khud isi topic ke shuru mein kehti hai ke safaid khoon ke cells bone marrow mein bante hain. Lymphoid tissues (lymph nodes, tilli) mein yeh baad mein pohanch kar kaam karte hain.

T cells bone marrow ke stem cells se ban kar thymus, dil ke bilkul oopar aik chhote surmai ghudood, mein jate hain jahan pukhta ho kar hamla awar jaraseem par bairooni molecules (antigens) pehchanna seekhte hain. Karoron mukhtalif T cells bante hain, har aik aik khaas antigen pehchanne ka mahir, is liye koi hamla awar kam az kam chand T cells ki pehchan se nahi bachta.

blocks.caption: T cells ki chaar bari qismein
rows: thymus mein T cells ki nashonuma ki nigrani

blocks.text: B cells bhi bone marrow mein bante hain lekin thymus nahi jate; yeh apni pukhtagi bone marrow mein mukammal kar ke khoon aur lymph mein chhore jate hain. Har B cell, T cell ki tarah, aik khaas antigen pehchanta hai. Apne antigen se milne par yeh bohat se plasma cells mein bat'ta hai, har aik aisi antibody banata jo antigen se chipak kar us par tabahi ka nishan lagati hai.

blocks.prompt: T cells aur B cells kahan pukhta hote hain?
blocks.explanation: T cells thymus mein; B cells bone marrow mein. Dono bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain.

items: Safaid cells bone marrow mein bante; lymph nodes, tilli, jigar, thymus mein milte.
Monocytes macrophages bante; T cells (helper, cytotoxic, inducer, suppressor) thymus mein pukhta.
B cells bone marrow mein pukhta; plasma cells antibodies banate.
